search_text: published ZDI-18-031 ZDI-CAN-4999 Advantech WebAccess webvrpcs drawsrv SQLParamData Untrusted Pointer Dereference Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2018-01-05 CVE-2017-16728 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-16728 6.8 AV:N/AC:M/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the 0x27ec IOCTL in the webvrpcs process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied value prior to dereferencing it as a pointer. An attacker can leverage this functionality to execute code under the context of Administrator. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
